# Second run profile (approximate, treated as cost proportional to time) COST_PER_STRAIGHT_CELL_SECOND_RUN = 1.0 COST_PER_TURN_SECOND_RUN = 0.5
# === Time-aware planning (DAT--3, DAT--5) === EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000 # 5 minutes NOMINAL_CELL_TRAVERSAL_MS = 800 # default for exploration profile (DAT--3)
# === Sensor filtering (DAT--5) === SAMPLING_FREQUENCY_HZ = 20 # default, within [10,50] ULTRASONIC_FILTER_WINDOW = 3 IR_FILTER_WINDOW = 3 CONSISTENCY_THRESHOLD_N = 3
CONTROL_LOOP_PERIOD_MS = int(1000 / SAMPLING_FREQUENCY_HZ)
# === Motion primitives and safety (DAT--4, DAT--6) === MAX_EXPLORATION_SPEED = 40 # [0..100] duty MAX_SECOND_RUN_SPEED = 70 # [0..100] duty MAX_SPEED_DELTA_PER_CYCLE = 10 # rate limiting except emergency stop

# Tracing: DAT--7, CMP--1, CMP--11
import time
class EventType: # High-level mission and exploration events (DAT--7) EXPLORATION_COMPLETED = "EXPLORATION_COMPLETED" EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT = "EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT" PATH_INVALIDATED = "PATH_INVALIDATED" RETURN_COMPLETED = "RETURN_COMPLETED" SECOND_RUN_COMPLETED = "SECOND_RUN_COMPLETED"
class Event: """ Simple event structure matching DAT--7. """ # Tracing: DAT--7 __slots__ = ("etype", "timestamp_ms", "payload")
def __init__(self, etype, payload=None): self.etype = etype self.timestamp_ms = time.ticks_ms() self.payload = payload
class EventQueue: """ Fixed-size circular buffer for events (DAT--7). Used mainly by CMP--11 (exploration status) and CMP--1 (mission control). """ # Tracing: DAT--7, CMP--1, CMP--11 def __init__(self, capacity=16): self._buf = [None] * capacity self._capacity = capacity self._head = 0 self._tail = 0 self._size = 0
def enqueue(self, event): if self._size == self._capacity: # Drop oldest event on overflow (policy for simplicity) self._head = (self._head + 1) % self._capacity self._size -= 1 self._buf[self._tail] = event self._tail = (self._tail + 1) % self._capacity self._size += 1
def dequeue(self): if self._size == 0: return None e = self._buf[self._head] self._buf[self._head] = None self._head = (self._head + 1) % self._capacity self._size -= 1 return e
def drain(self): """ Yield all events currently queued and empty the queue. """ events = [] while True: e = self.dequeue() if e is None: break events.append(e) return events

from core import config
# === Enums (DAT--1) === class CellState: CELL_UNKNOWN = 0 CELL_FREE = 1 CELL_BLOCKED = 2
class WallState: WALL_UNKNOWN = 0 WALL_PRESENT = 1 WALL_ABSENT = 2
class GridMap: """ In-memory 4x8 grid map with wall segments and completeness tracking.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--3 (Grid Map Module) - Requirements: LL--MAP--1.3.x, LL--MAP--1.4.x (via Design) - Additional data: DAT--1 (data structures) """
def __init__(self, start_row=0, start_col=0): # CMP--3.Execution: Map initialization at startup self.rows = config.GRID_ROWS self.cols = config.GRID_COLS
# Cells: 4x8 self.cells = [[CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN for _ in range(self.cols)] for _ in range(self.rows)] # Horizontal walls: between row and row+1 -> (rows-1) x cols self.h_walls = [[WallState.WALL_UNKNOWN for _ in range(self.cols)] for _ in range(self.rows - 1)] # Vertical walls: between col and col+1 -> rows x (cols-1) self.v_walls = [[WallState.WALL_UNKNOWN for _ in range(self.cols - 1)] for _ in range(self.rows)]
self.start_row = start_row self.start_col = start_col
# Completeness counters (CMP--3.Execution step 6) self.unknown_cells = self.rows * self.cols self.unknown_walls = (self.rows - 1) * self.cols + self.rows * (self.cols - 1) self.map_complete = False
# Initialize start cell as FREE self._set_cell_state_internal(start_row, start_col, CellState.CELL_FREE)
# === Internal helpers enforcing invariants (CMP--3.Invariants) ===
def _in_bounds_cell(self, row, col): return 0 <= row < self.rows and 0 <= col < self.cols
def _in_bounds_hwall(self, r, c): return 0 <= r < self.rows - 1 and 0 <= c < self.cols
def _in_bounds_vwall(self, r, c): return 0 <= r < self.rows and 0 <= c < self.cols - 1
def _set_cell_state_internal(self, row, col, new_state): if not self._in_bounds_cell(row, col): return False old = self.cells[row][col] if old == new_state: return True # Allowed transitions: UNKNOWN -> FREE/BLOCKED only (CMP--3.Invariants) if old != CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN: return False self.cells[row][col] = new_state if old == CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN: self.unknown_cells -= 1 self._update_completeness_flag() return True
def _set_wall_state_internal(self, vertical, r, c, new_state): if vertical: if not self._in_bounds_vwall(r, c): return False arr = self.v_walls else: if not self._in_bounds_hwall(r, c): return False arr = self.h_walls old = arr[r][c] if old == new_state: return True # Allowed transitions: UNKNOWN -> PRESENT/ABSENT only (CMP--3.Invariants) if old != WallState.WALL_UNKNOWN: return False arr[r][c] = new_state if old == WallState.WALL_UNKNOWN: self.unknown_walls -= 1 self._update_completeness_flag() return True
def _update_completeness_flag(self): # CMP--3.Execution step 6 self.map_complete = (self.unknown_cells == 0 and self.unknown_walls == 0)
# === Public API (GM_MapData, GM_MapCompletenessFlag in CMP--3.ConnectedComponents) ===
def get_cell_state(self, row, col): if not self._in_bounds_cell(row, col): return None return self.cells[row][col]
def get_neighbors4(self, row, col): # 4-connected adjacency (used by FGM and planner) res = [] for dr, dc in ((-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)): nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc if self._in_bounds_cell(nr, nc): res.append((nr, nc)) return res
def get_wall_state_between(self, r1, c1, r2, c2): # Horizontal adjacency if r1 == r2 and abs(c1 - c2) == 1: r = r1 c = min(c1, c2) return self.v_walls[r][c] # Vertical adjacency if c1 == c2 and abs(r1 - r2) == 1: r = min(r1, r2) c = c1 return self.h_walls[r][c] return None
def is_complete(self): # GM_MapCompletenessFlag (CMP--3.Transmit) return self.map_complete
# === Map update requests (MM_MapUpdateRequest handlers for CMP--6) ===
def apply_cell_free_request(self, row, col): """ UNKNOWN -> FREE request (CMP--3.Execution, MM_MapUpdateRequest, UNKNOWN->FREE) """ return self._set_cell_state_internal(row, col, CellState.CELL_FREE)
def apply_cell_blocked_request(self, row, col): """ UNKNOWN -> BLOCKED request (CMP--3.Execution, MM_MapUpdateRequest, UNKNOWN->BLOCKED) """ return self._set_cell_state_internal(row, col, CellState.CELL_BLOCKED)
def apply_wall_present_request(self, r1, c1, r2, c2): """ UNKNOWN -> PRESENT wall request and blocked cell inference for neighbor cell (CMP--3.Execution 2,5). """ # Decide vertical vs horizontal if r1 == r2 and abs(c1 - c2) == 1: # vertical wall r = r1 c = min(c1, c2) ok = self._set_wall_state_internal(True, r, c, WallState.WALL_PRESENT) elif c1 == c2 and abs(r1 - r2) == 1: # horizontal wall r = min(r1, r2) c = c1 ok = self._set_wall_state_internal(False, r, c, WallState.WALL_PRESENT) else: return False # neighbor blocked inference (LL--MAP--1.4.4) # For simplicity, infer blocked on the farther cell if r1 == r2: blocked_row, blocked_col = r1, max(c1, c2) else: blocked_row, blocked_col = max(r1, r2), c1 self.apply_cell_blocked_request(blocked_row, blocked_col) return ok
def apply_wall_absent_request(self, r1, c1, r2, c2): """ UNKNOWN -> ABSENT wall request (CMP--3.Execution 3). """ if r1 == r2 and abs(c1 - c2) == 1: r = r1 c = min(c1, c2) return self._set_wall_state_internal(True, r, c, WallState.WALL_ABSENT) if c1 == c2 and abs(r1 - r2) == 1: r = min(r1, r2) c = c1 return self._set_wall_state_internal(False, r, c, WallState.WALL_ABSENT) return False

from core import config from core.grid_map import CellState
class PlanningStatus: SUCCESS = "SUCCESS" FAILURE_NO_PATH = "FAILURE_NO_PATH" FAILURE_TIMEOUT = "FAILURE_TIMEOUT" INVALID_GOAL = "INVALID_GOAL"
class PlannerResponse: """ Models PL_PathPlanningResponse (CMP--4.Transmit). """ def __init__(self, request_id, status, path=None, total_cost=0.0, est_time_ms=0): self.request_id = request_id self.status = status self.path = path or [] self.total_cost = total_cost self.estimated_time_ms = est_time_ms
class PathPlanner: """ Simple A*-like planner on 4x8 grid.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--4 - Uses traversal cost model DAT--2 """
def __init__(self, grid_map): self.map = grid_map
def _neighbors_free(self, cell): r, c = cell res = [] for nr, nc in self.map.get_neighbors4(r, c): if self.map.get_cell_state(nr, nc) != CellState.CELL_FREE: continue wall_state = self.map.get_wall_state_between(r, c, nr, nc) from core.grid_map import WallState if wall_state == WallState.WALL_PRESENT: continue res.append((nr, nc)) return res
def _heuristic(self, a, b): # Manhattan distance, scaled by BASE_STRAIGHT_COST (DAT--2) return (abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1])) * config.BASE_STRAIGHT_COST
def plan(self, request_id, mode, start_cell, goal_cells): """ mode in {"EXPLORE", "RETURN_TO_START", "SECOND_RUN"} goal_cells: list of candidate goal cells. """ # Validate if not goal_cells: return PlannerResponse(request_id, PlanningStatus.INVALID_GOAL)
# Multi-goal: run single-source A* until we reach any of them. # For small 4x8 grid, this is fine. open_set = [start_cell] came_from = {} g_score = {start_cell: 0.0} from heapq import heappush, heappop heap = [] goal_set = set(goal_cells) goal_reached = None
heappush(heap, (0.0, start_cell))
while heap: _, current = heappop(heap) if current in goal_set: goal_reached = current break for nb in self._neighbors_free(current): tentative_g = g_score[current] + config.BASE_STRAIGHT_COST if nb not in g_score or tentative_g < g_score[nb]: g_score[nb] = tentative_g came_from[nb] = current # Use heuristic toward closest goal h_vals = [self._heuristic(nb, g) for g in goal_cells] h = min(h_vals) if h_vals else 0.0 f = tentative_g + h heappush(heap, (f, nb))
if goal_reached is None: return PlannerResponse(request_id, PlanningStatus.FAILURE_NO_PATH)
# Reconstruct path path = [goal_reached] cur = goal_reached while cur != start_cell: cur = came_from[cur] path.append(cur) path.reverse()
total_cost = g_score[goal_reached] est_time_ms = int(len(path) * config.NOMINAL_CELL_TRAVERSAL_MS) return PlannerResponse( request_id=request_id, status=PlanningStatus.SUCCESS, path=path, total_cost=total_cost, est_time_ms=est_time_ms, )

from core.grid_map import CellState
class GoalRegionInfo: """ Represents selected goal region for second run (CMP--5.Transmit). """ def __init__(self, cells=None, chosen_goal_cell=None, cost=0.0): self.cells = cells or [] self.chosen_goal_cell = chosen_goal_cell self.cost = cost
class GoalRegionSelector: """ Goal Region Identification and Selection.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--5 """
def __init__(self, grid_map, planner): self.map = grid_map self.planner = planner self.selected_region = None
def identify_and_select(self, start_cell): """ Implements CMP--5.Execution. Enumerate 2x2 blocks, check all FREE, compute path via planner, pick minimal cost. """ rows = self.map.rows cols = self.map.cols best_region = None best_cost = None best_goal_cell = None
region_id = 0 for r in range(rows - 1): for c in range(cols - 1): cells = [(r, c), (r, c + 1), (r + 1, c), (r + 1, c + 1)] all_free = True for (rr, cc) in cells: if self.map.get_cell_state(rr, cc) != CellState.CELL_FREE: all_free = False break if not all_free: continue # Ask planner for cheapest path to any cell in region req_id = "GR_%d" % region_id from core.planner import PlanningStatus resp = self.planner.plan(req_id, "SECOND_RUN", start_cell, cells) if resp.status != PlanningStatus.SUCCESS or not resp.path: continue cost = resp.total_cost goal_cell = resp.path[-1] if best_cost is None or cost < best_cost: best_cost = cost best_region = cells best_goal_cell = goal_cell region_id += 1
if best_region is None: self.selected_region = None return None
info = GoalRegionInfo(best_region, best_goal_cell, best_cost) self.selected_region = info return info

import time from collections import deque from core import config
class FilteredSensorData: """ Normalized filtered sensor data (CMP--7.Transmit SAL_FilteredSensorData). """ def __init__(self, dist_cm=999.0, left=False, right=False, ts_ms=0): self.distance_cm = dist_cm self.left_flag = left self.right_flag = right self.timestamp_ms = ts_ms
class SensorAbstractionLayer: """ Sensor Abstraction and Filtering Layer.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--7 - AdditionalData: DAT--5 """
def __init__(self, ultrasonic_drv, infrared_drv): self.ultrasonic = ultrasonic_drv self.infrared = infrared_drv self.ultra_buf = deque(maxlen=config.ULTRASONIC_FILTER_WINDOW) self.ir_left_buf = deque(maxlen=config.IR_FILTER_WINDOW) self.ir_right_buf = deque(maxlen=config.IR_FILTER_WINDOW) self.sensor_available = False
def _filter_avg_bool(self, buf): if not buf: return False return sum(1 for v in buf if v) * 2 >= len(buf)
def _filter_avg_float(self, buf): if not buf: return 999.0 return sum(buf) / len(buf)
def sample_and_filter(self): """ To be called once per control loop (Sched_ControlLoopTick, CMP--7.Execution). """ ts = time.ticks_ms()
# Raw sampling (CMP--7.Execution step 1) raw_dist = self.ultrasonic.distance() raw_left = bool(self.infrared.dsl()) raw_right = bool(self.infrared.dsr())
# Sanitize ultrasonic (CMP--7.Execution step 2) if raw_dist is None or raw_dist < 0 or raw_dist != raw_dist: # NaN check dist = 999.0 valid_ultra = False else: dist = raw_dist valid_ultra = True
# Assume IR always returns a bool; treat as valid self.ultra_buf.append(dist) self.ir_left_buf.append(raw_left) self.ir_right_buf.append(raw_right)
filtered_dist = self._filter_avg_float(self.ultra_buf) filtered_left = self._filter_avg_bool(self.ir_left_buf) filtered_right = self._filter_avg_bool(self.ir_right_buf)
# Update availability status (CMP--7.Transmit SensorAvailabilityStatus) if valid_ultra: if filtered_left is not None and filtered_right is not None: self.sensor_available = True
return FilteredSensorData( dist_cm=filtered_dist, left=filtered_left, right=filtered_right, ts_ms=ts, )

from core import config from core.grid_map import CellState
class WallDetectionResult: """ Simple structure for MM_WallDetectionResult (CMP--6.Transmit). """ def __init__(self, front=False, left=False, right=False): self.front = front self.left = left self.right = right
class MappingModule: """ Mapping and Wall Detection Module.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--6 - Requirements tied via Design to LL--MAP--1.2.x, 1.3.x, 1.4.x """
def __init__(self, grid_map): self.map = grid_map # Hysteresis and consistency state (DAT--5) self.front_count = 0 self.left_count = 0 self.right_count = 0
def process(self, filtered_data, pose_estimate): """ Per control loop processing (CMP--6.Execution).
Args: filtered_data: FilteredSensorData from SAL (CMP--7). pose_estimate: PoseEstimate from CMP--9. Returns: WallDetectionResult for motion control and pose correction. """ front = False left = False right = False
# 2) Front wall detection via ultrasonic (simplified, DAT--4) d = filtered_data.distance_cm expected = config.CELL_LENGTH_CM / 2.0 # approximate, from DAT--4 lo = expected - 12.0 hi = expected + 12.0 if lo <= d <= hi: self.front_count += 1 else: self.front_count = 0
if self.front_count >= config.CONSISTENCY_THRESHOLD_N: front = True
# 2) Side walls via IR (simplified) if filtered_data.left_flag: self.left_count += 1 else: self.left_count = 0
if filtered_data.right_flag: self.right_count += 1 else: self.right_count = 0
if self.left_count >= config.CONSISTENCY_THRESHOLD_N: left = True if self.right_count >= config.CONSISTENCY_THRESHOLD_N: right = True
# Map updates (highly simplified for demo; real impl would map walls to edges) r, c = pose_estimate.row, pose_estimate.col if front: # mark next cell as BLOCKED if UNKNOWN (CMP--6.Execution step 5) dr, dc = pose_estimate.heading_delta() nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc if self.map.get_cell_state(nr, nc) == CellState.CELL_UNKNOWN: self.map.apply_cell_blocked_request(nr, nc)
# Free cell confirmation on successful traversal is done via Pose/MC in this simplified version return WallDetectionResult(front=front, left=left, right=right)

def heading_delta(self): """ Return (dr, dc) motion vector for one-cell forward move. """ if self.heading_idx == 0: # NORTH -> negative row return -1, 0 if self.heading_idx == 1: # EAST return 0, 1 if self.heading_idx == 2: # SOUTH return 1, 0 # WEST return 0, -1

For demonstration: - If both positive: move forward one cell when enough cycles accumulated. - If left>right: turn right 90 over some cycles, etc.
Full continuous model omitted due to platform constraints. """ # Stub: no continuous integration, assume mission control triggers cell-level updates pass

# Tracing: CMP--8, DAT--4, DAT--6
from core import config from drivers.motor_driver import MotorDriver
class PathExecutionStatus: RUNNING = "RUNNING" REACHED_GOAL = "REACHED_GOAL" PATH_INVALID = "PATH_INVALID" COLLISION_ABORTED = "COLLISION_ABORTED"
class MotionController: """ Motion Control and Collision Avoidance.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--8 - AdditionalData: DAT--4, DAT--6 """
MODE_NORMAL = 0 MODE_AVOIDANCE = 1 MODE_EMERGENCY_STOPPED = 2
def __init__(self, motor: MotorDriver): self.motor = motor self.mode = self.MODE_NORMAL self.left_speed = 0 self.right_speed = 0 self.current_path = [] self.path_index = 0 self.speed_profile = "ExplorationSpeed"
def _apply_rate_limited(self, target_left, target_right): """ Enforce rate limiting per CMP--8.Invariants, except for emergency stop. """ dl = target_left - self.left_speed dr = target_right - self.right_speed max_delta = config.MAX_SPEED_DELTA_PER_CYCLE if dl > max_delta: dl = max_delta if dl < -max_delta: dl = -max_delta if dr > max_delta: dr = max_delta if dr < -max_delta: dr = -max_delta self.left_speed += dl self.right_speed += dr self.motor.set(self.left_speed, self.right_speed)
def emergency_stop(self): """ Immediate EM stop (CMP--8.Failures Emergency stop). """ self.mode = self.MODE_EMERGENCY_STOPPED self.left_speed = 0 self.right_speed = 0 self.motor.stop()
def set_motion_command(self, path, speed_profile): """ Accept MC_MotionCommand from CMP--1.
Args: path: list of cells to follow. speed_profile: {"ExplorationSpeed", "ReturnSpeed", "SecondRunSpeed"}. """ if self.mode == self.MODE_EMERGENCY_STOPPED: # Accept new safe command to leave EMERGENCY_STOPPED (CMP--8.Invariants) self.mode = self.MODE_NORMAL self.current_path = list(path or []) self.path_index = 0 self.speed_profile = speed_profile
def _profile_speed(self): if self.speed_profile == "SecondRunSpeed": return config.MAX_SECOND_RUN_SPEED return config.MAX_EXPLORATION_SPEED
def tick(self, filtered_sensor, wall_detection): """ Per control loop step (CMP--8.Execution).
Args: filtered_sensor: FilteredSensorData from SAL. wall_detection: WallDetectionResult from Mapping. Returns: PathExecutionStatus or None when still running. """ # 2) Emergency stop check if self.mode != self.MODE_EMERGENCY_STOPPED: if filtered_sensor.distance_cm <= config.EMERGENCY_STOP_DISTANCE_CM: self.emergency_stop() return PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED
if self.mode == self.MODE_EMERGENCY_STOPPED: # Keep motors stopped self.motor.stop() return PathExecutionStatus.PATH_INVALID
# Simplified path following: if path not empty, just drive forward if not self.current_path or self.path_index >= len(self.current_path) - 1: # No path or at final cell: stop self._apply_rate_limited(0, 0) return PathExecutionStatus.REACHED_GOAL
# In actual implementation we would use pose to progress; here we just # move along discrete path index each tick for demonstration. target_speed = self._profile_speed() self._apply_rate_limited(target_speed, target_speed) self.path_index += 1 return PathExecutionStatus.RUNNING

# Tracing: CMP--11
import time from core import config from core.events import EventQueue, Event, EventType
class ExplorationStatusModule: """ Exploration Status and Time Limit Module.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--11 """
def __init__(self, grid_map): self.map = grid_map self.events = EventQueue() self.explore_started = False self.start_time_ms = 0 self.completed_emitted = False self.timeout_emitted = False
def notify_explore_start(self): # Called by Mission Control when entering EXPLORE (FSM--1, CMP--1) self.explore_started = True self.start_time_ms = time.ticks_ms()
def tick(self): """ Called once per control loop by scheduler (CMP--11.Execution). """ if not self.explore_started: return
now = time.ticks_ms() elapsed = time.ticks_diff(now, self.start_time_ms) if (not self.timeout_emitted) and elapsed >= config.EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS: self.timeout_emitted = True self.events.enqueue(Event(EventType.EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT))
if (not self.completed_emitted) and self.map.is_complete(): self.completed_emitted = True self.events.enqueue(Event(EventType.EXPLORATION_COMPLETED))
def remaining_time_ms(self): if not self.explore_started: return config.EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS now = time.ticks_ms() elapsed = time.ticks_diff(now, self.start_time_ms) rem = config.EXPLORATION_TIME_LIMIT_MS - elapsed if rem < 0: rem = 0 return rem

# Tracing: CMP--1, FSM--1
from core.events import EventType from core.planner import PlanningStatus from core.motion import PathExecutionStatus
class MissionState: IDLE = "IDLE" EXPLORE = "EXPLORE" RETURN_TO_START = "RETURN_TO_START" SECOND_RUN = "SECOND_RUN" COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"
class SecondRunStatusEnum: # Subset of DAT--1.SecondRunStatusEnum mapped to high-level values SECOND_RUN_NOT_EXECUTED = 0 SECOND_RUN_SUCCESS = 1 SECOND_RUN_FAILURE = 2
class MissionControl: """ Mission Control State Machine, implementing FSM--1.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--1 - State Machine: FSM--1 """
def __init__(self, grid_map, frontier, planner, goal_region_selector, exploration_status_module, motion_controller, pose_estimator, sal): self.grid_map = grid_map self.frontier = frontier self.planner = planner self.goal_region_selector = goal_region_selector self.es = exploration_status_module self.motion = motion_controller self.pose_estimator = pose_estimator self.sal = sal
self.state = MissionState.IDLE self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_NOT_EXECUTED self.return_reason = None self.init_completed = False
def set_init_completed(self): self.init_completed = True
def tick(self): """ Execute one mission control cycle (CMP--1.Execution). """ pose = self.pose_estimator.get_pose()
if self.state == MissionState.IDLE: # FSM--1.IDLE StateAction self.motion.set_motion_command([], "ExplorationSpeed") if self.init_completed and self.sal.sensor_available: # FSM--1: IDLE -> EXPLORE transition self.state = MissionState.EXPLORE self.es.notify_explore_start() # TransitionAction: reset timers, init exploration modules
elif self.state == MissionState.EXPLORE: # Check exploration events (CMP--11 -> CMP--1) for ev in self.es.events.drain(): if ev.etype == EventType.EXPLORATION_COMPLETED: self.return_reason = "COMPLETED" self.state = MissionState.RETURN_TO_START elif ev.etype == EventType.EXPLORATION_TIMEOUT: if self.state != MissionState.RETURN_TO_START: self.return_reason = "TIMEOUT" self.state = MissionState.RETURN_TO_START
if self.state == MissionState.EXPLORE: # Request frontier and plan remaining = self.es.remaining_time_ms() target = self.frontier.select_target((pose.row, pose.col), remaining) if target.cell is not None: resp = self.planner.plan( request_id="EXPLORE", mode="EXPLORE", start_cell=(pose.row, pose.col), goal_cells=[target.cell], ) if resp.status == PlanningStatus.SUCCESS: self.motion.set_motion_command(resp.path, "ExplorationSpeed")
elif self.state == MissionState.RETURN_TO_START: # Request path to start cell if not yet done start_cell = (self.grid_map.start_row, self.grid_map.start_col) resp = self.planner.plan( request_id="RETURN", mode="RETURN_TO_START", start_cell=(pose.row, pose.col), goal_cells=[start_cell], ) if resp.status == PlanningStatus.SUCCESS: self.motion.set_motion_command(resp.path, "ReturnSpeed") status = self.motion.tick(self.sal.sample_and_filter(), None) if status == PathExecutionStatus.REACHED_GOAL: # FSM--1: RETURN_TO_START -> SECOND_RUN self.state = MissionState.SECOND_RUN else: # Planning failure (CMP--1.Failures) self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED
elif self.state == MissionState.SECOND_RUN: # Determine goal region if not selected if not self.goal_region_selector.selected_region: info = self.goal_region_selector.identify_and_select( (self.grid_map.start_row, self.grid_map.start_col) ) if info is None: self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED return
goal_cells = self.goal_region_selector.selected_region.cells resp = self.planner.plan( request_id="SECOND", mode="SECOND_RUN", start_cell=(self.grid_map.start_row, self.grid_map.start_col), goal_cells=goal_cells, ) if resp.status != PlanningStatus.SUCCESS: self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED return
self.motion.set_motion_command(resp.path, "SecondRunSpeed") status = self.motion.tick(self.sal.sample_and_filter(), None) if status == PathExecutionStatus.REACHED_GOAL: self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_SUCCESS self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED elif status == PathExecutionStatus.COLLISION_ABORTED: self.second_run_status = SecondRunStatusEnum.SECOND_RUN_FAILURE self.state = MissionState.COMPLETED
elif self.state == MissionState.COMPLETED: # FSM--1.COMPLETED StateAction self.motion.set_motion_command([], "ExplorationSpeed") # MC_SecondRunStatusOutput latched by second_run_status pass

# Tracing: CMP--10
import time from core import config
class Scheduler: """ Scheduler and Initialization.
Tracing: - Component: CMP--10 """
def __init__(self, mission_control, sal, mapping, pose_estimator, grid_map, exploration_status, motion_controller): self.mc = mission_control self.sal = sal self.mapping = mapping self.pose_estimator = pose_estimator self.grid_map = grid_map self.es = exploration_status self.motion = motion_controller
def initialize(self): """ Hardware and software init (CMP--10.Execution startup). """ # In this simple implementation, assume init always succeeds. self.mc.set_init_completed()
def run(self): """ Main control loop (CMP--10.Execution periodic). """ period_ms = config.CONTROL_LOOP_PERIOD_MS next_tick = time.ticks_ms()
while True: now = time.ticks_ms() if time.ticks_diff(now, next_tick) < 0: # Sleep until next period time.sleep_ms(1) continue
# 1) Emit Sched_ControlLoopTick (implicit by ticking components) next_tick = time.ticks_add(next_tick, period_ms)
# 2) Sample sensors filtered = self.sal.sample_and_filter()
# 3) Update mapping (walls, cells) using last pose pose = self.pose_estimator.get_pose() wall_det = self.mapping.process(filtered, pose)
# 4) Exploration status timing self.es.tick()
# 5) Mission control state machine self.mc.tick()
# 6) Motion control (if not already advanced within MC) self.motion.tick(filtered, wall_det)
